_comment: Named villagers: about 1 in 5 arriving villagers (chance) gets a name from content/names.json and one of these one-line stories. {name} is replaced with the name. role: what they do; a 'farmer', 'woodcutter' or 'fisher' story is only given once the barangay has the building in roleBuildings, a 'warrior' story only while there are Mandirigma without a story. first: only for the first villager ever named. Filipino text needs a native speaker's review.

text.en: {name}, the first child born in your barangay
text.fil: Si {name}, ang unang batang isinilang sa iyong barangay

text.en: {name}, who can throw a spear across the river
text.fil: Si {name}, na kayang ihagis ang sibat sa kabila ng ilog

text.en: {name}, who can smell rain coming over the paddies
text.fil: Si {name}, na naaamoy ang paparating na ulan sa palayan

text.en: {name}, who plants the first seedling every season
text.fil: Si {name}, na nagtatanim ng unang punla tuwing panahon

text.en: {name}, who knows when bamboo is ready to cut
text.fil: Si {name}, na alam kung kailan handa nang putulin ang kawayan

text.en: {name}, who leaves a little rice for the anito of the balete before every cut
text.fil: Si {name}, na nag-iiwan ng kaunting bigas para sa anito ng balete bago pumutol

text.en: {name}, who once caught a dalag as long as an arm
text.fil: Si {name}, na minsang nakahuli ng dalag na kasinghaba ng braso

text.en: {name}, the best singer at every harvest
text.fil: Si {name}, ang pinakamahusay umawit tuwing anihan

text.en: {name}, who weaves the finest banig in the barangay
text.fil: Si {name}, na naghahabi ng pinakamagandang banig sa barangay

text.en: {name}, who tells the children stories of the anito of the balete
text.fil: Si {name}, na nagkukuwento sa mga bata tungkol sa anito ng balete

text.en: {name}, who still remembers the great flood
text.fil: Si {name}, na naaalala pa ang malaking baha

text.en: {name}, who came upriver by bangka looking for a new home
text.fil: Si {name}, na dumating sakay ng bangka upang humanap ng bagong tahanan
